requirements: Workload: hybrid — chat for end-users (session state), embeddings for semantic search + reranking, lightweight summarization for long docs
Latency targets: chat p50 <120ms, p95 <300ms for typical prompts (~200 tokens); occasional long-run (1k tokens) acceptable up to 800ms
Throughput: embeddings pipeline ~50-200 qps depending on daily batch windows; peak concurrent chat sessions ~600
Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; aim to keep hosted-equivalent TCO <= $0.25/MAU uplift; prefer committed capacity if it halves per-token cost
Model preferences: prefer open models (13B for low-latency paths, 70B quantized for higher-quality reranking) with fallbacks to smaller variants
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to smaller model when latency target breached and a canary policy for rollouts
poc_metrics: Accuracy: semantic-search MRR +0.12 vs baseline retrieval-only
Performance: p50 latency target <120ms on dedicated baseline for 13B quantized model
Cost: unit cost per 1k tokens target <$0.35 in POC model, goal <$0.20 on committed Dedicated
Reliability: failover to Hosted fallback with <2s added latency during capacity spikes
workshop_outcomes: Batching: dynamic batching with adaptive thresholds reduced per-token GPU time by ~30% in synthetic tests
Caching: prefix/KV caching for session re-asks estimated to save ~40-65% of tokens for our typical dialog patterns
Quantization: int8/profiled quantization recommended for 13B path; estimated quality loss minimal for reranking/embeddings workloads
Unit economics: modeled scenario shows transition Hosted -> Dedicated cuts per-token cost ~2.3x under 24/7 load assumptions; break-even at ~6M tokens/day
Ops: recommended autoscale + burst pool for tail spikes; suggested SLA targets and fallback routing policy
